olivia_csm: Heads-up: onboarding webhooks to our email provider are intermittently failing since ~07:25 UTC, causing verification emails and onboarding callbacks to stall for some new tenants. Drafting customer comms and need finance + ops signoff for remediation offers. Incident INC-2025-981. @jamal_support @steve_eng please confirm scope and ETA.
jamal_support: Confirmed. Delivery errors show 502/504 from third-party provider on webhook POSTs; retries exhausted by our worker after 3 attempts. Affected cohort: ~23 trial tenants created in the last 72h. Sample log: `webhook.send tenant=tn-77 status=504 attempts=3`
steve_eng: Root cause: upstream provider outage causing transient gateway errors. Short-term plan: enable fallback provider for webhooks and increase retry window to 15m. Pete/Ops can flip the provider flag per-cohort. Long term: add multi-provider fanout and circuit-breaker. Canary for fallback in us-east-1 at 08:40 UTC; full flip target 09:10 UTC.
incident-bot: INC-2025-981 | created | severity: medium-high | impacted: ~23 trial tenants | status: mitigation in-progress
liam_csm: Of the 23, 6 have trials ending within 14 days and 2 are high-touch renewals. We should prepare an exec-level outreach for the 2 and an extended-trial offer for the rest.
emily_finance: Finance note: We can approve a 14-day trial extension for the impacted cohort and up to two priority enablement workshops for at-risk accounts. Tag credits with INC-2025-981 for accounting.
olivia_csm: Draft short trial message: "Hi  were aware verification emails and onboarding callbacks are delayed for a small set of new tenants due to a third-party email provider outage. Engineers have enabled a fallback and expect normal onboarding to resume within ~30\t60 minutes. Affected trials will automatically receive a 14-day extension and an offer for a 30-min priority onboarding session. Reply to schedule.  Olivia, Redwood CSM"
jamal_support: Add a quick customer workaround: use Console to manually resend verification or trigger a retry for the onboarding job. Sanitized retry via Console or API: `POST /v1/onboard/retry {"tenant_id":"tn-77"}`
pete_ops: Enabling fallback provider now for the impacted cohort and increasing retry window. Monitoring delivery success and callback rates; will post metrics in 10m.
steve_eng: Once fallback shows success we'll post a public status update and CS can send the trial blast. I'll prepare a one-line technical RCA for the follow-up: "Cause: upstream email provider outage led to webhook delivery failures; we mitigated via fallback and retry tuning." Full postmortem to follow.
liam_csm: Exec outreach draft: "Hello  were contacting you proactively: onboarding verifications for a small number of trial tenants were delayed due to an upstream email provider issue. We've enabled an immediate fallback and expect full onboarding to resume shortly. To mitigate impact we will (1) apply a 14-day trial extension, (2) schedule a priority 30-min enablement session within 3 business days, and (3) assign a CS lead for direct coordination. We will follow up with an RCA and a short impact survey. Please reply with preferred times for a call.  Olivia"
olivia_csm: Final asks: Ops confirm fallback metrics look healthy, Eng confirm public status update, Finance ack done. Once Pete confirms I'll send the two templates and DM the 6 near-expiry tenant IDs for prioritized outreach. Thanks all.
